{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id counts:")
duplicate_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = duplicate_counts[duplicate_counts > 1]
print(duplicates)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:")
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum())

# Check for assay_batch unit error
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:")
print(df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Note: The question asks about sites, but data has only 3 sites
print("\nUnique sites:")
print(df['site'].unique())"}
